introHtml:
As the holiday season approaches, finding the perfect giveaway for clients or employees can be challenging. Our collection of custom excluded products offers unique, high-quality items that stand out from typical promotional fare. From tech gadgets like the NFC Slim Pen to stylish accessories like the Dan Denim Tote, these pieces are designed to impress. Marketing directors and HR managers alike appreciate the versatility and appeal of these products for corporate gifts, event giveaways, and employee appreciation.

Safety managers and business owners will find practical options such as the Click-It Kit and Steal Umbrella, which are both useful and memorable. Whether you need bulk orders for a trade show or personalized items for a company milestone, our excluded products deliver quality and customization. Explore this curated selection to find items that align with your brand and make a lasting impression on recipients.
buyingGuideHtml:
Custom Excluded Products Buying Guide

When ordering custom excluded products, focus on quality and uniqueness. Unlike standard promotional items, these products often feature specialized materials or designs. For instance, the NFC Slim Pen combines technology with everyday use, while the Glass Bento Box offers a premium lunch solution. Look for durable construction and functional appeal to ensure recipients keep and use your branded items.

Materials vary widely in this category. The Dan Denim Tote uses sturdy denim fabric, while the Pro-AM Shoe Bag is made from breathable mesh. Consider the environment where the product will be used: outdoor events call for weather-resistant items like the Steal Umbrella, while office settings suit sleek gadgets like the MagPatch. Durability matters for long-term brand exposure.

Common use cases include corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, employee onboarding kits, and client appreciation. Marketing directors often choose tech items like the NFC Slim Pen for their novelty, while HR directors prefer practical items like the Click-It Kit for safety programs. Business owners may opt for luxury items like the Chocolate Coins or Boutique Comb for high-end events.

Decoration options depend on the product. Screen printing works well on fabric items like the Puffer Belt Bag, while laser engraving is ideal for metal components on the Hammer Keytag. Full-color heat transfer suits the Dry Body Brush, and pad printing fits small plastic items like the Ruler Keytag. Always request a proof to ensure logo placement and color accuracy.

Minimum order quantities (MOQs) for custom excluded products typically range from 50 to 500 units. Bulk orders reduce per-unit costs, making them cost-effective for large events. For smaller runs, consider items like the Candy Gel Pen with lower MOQs. Order early to allow for production and shipping, especially during peak seasons. Avoid common mistakes like selecting the wrong size for apparel or neglecting to test electronic items for compatibility.

faqs.q: What are the minimum order quantities for excluded products?
faqs.a: MOQs vary by product, typically ranging from 50 to 500 units. Items like pens and keytags may have lower MOQs, while totes and electronics may require higher quantities. Contact us for specific product MOQs.

faqs.q: What decoration methods are available for these products?
faqs.a: Common methods include screen printing, laser engraving, heat transfer, and pad printing. The choice depends on the material and design complexity. We recommend a proof to ensure quality.

faqs.q: How long does production and shipping take?
faqs.a: Standard production takes 10-15 business days, plus shipping time. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. We advise ordering 4-6 weeks before your event.

faqs.q: Can I order samples before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, samples are available for most products. Sample costs are typically deducted from the final order. Contact your account manager to arrange samples.

faqs.q: Are there any size or color restrictions for customization?
faqs.a: Size and color options depend on the product. For example, the Dan Denim Tote comes in one size but multiple colors. Check product pages for details or ask for recommendations.
